name: The Day We Got Married
overview: After discovering her fiancé Matthew is having an affair with her stepsister, Caroline ends their engagement and finds herself drawn into an unexpected partnership with Jack, a seemingly ordinary man she meets after a life-changing accident. As Caroline fights to reclaim her late mother’s company from her scheming stepmother, she and Jack enter a marriage of convenience that gradually blossoms into love. Unaware that Jack is the heir to the powerful Stone family, Caroline faces betrayal, family conflicts, and corporate challenges on her journey to rebuild her mother's legacy and find happiness.
